name: FOMC post-announcement drift
hypothesis: On FOMC days, at 14:30 ET enter in the direction of the move since 13:55 ET if it exceeds 3 five-minute ATRs; hold to 5 minutes before the close; 3-ATR stop.

entry.long: event("fomc") == 1 and tod() == 870 and close - valuewhen(tod() == 835, close) > 3*atr(14)
entry.short: event("fomc") == 1 and tod() == 870 and close - valuewhen(tod() == 835, close) < -3*atr(14)
